ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 4:1 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity central region across both lobes. Low-intensity (dark) pigmentation is concentrated along the continuous trailing edge and outer distal tips. A distinct dark mottled patch is observed on the inner right lobe adjacent to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 65 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. The left lobe exhibits fine-grain peaks (2-5 pixel amplitude), while the right lobe shows high-amplitude, irregular indentations and deeper valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges of both lobes follow a concave curvature transitioning into an upward sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, circular low-contrast clusters (white on dark) visible on the extreme edges of both distal tips, consistent with barnacle attachment points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, high-contrast dark linear stroke is visible on the left lobe, oriented diagonally from the trailing edge towards the leading edge baseline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and heavy serration on the trailing edge of the right lobe, indicating historical physical trauma or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark vertical streaking on the trailing edge of the right lobe, contrasting sharply with the primary white ventral field.
